items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: ...he was just about on the built of Mr. Russell there. About the built of him...

ctx.x: What, what kind of a father was he, what was his appearance? Was he a tall father? Oh, a clam? Yeah.

Well, no, he wasn't so too, he was kind of, a little heavy set. He was just about on the built of Mr. Russell there. About the built of him and he had, he used to wear black glasses on the count of one eye, you see. He had one eye.
